quality_boundary: Seventh comprehensive plan (2018-2027, basic concept plus promotion plan), budget enactment confirmed on the official vote-result PDF, and settlement totals kept at the audit opinion's exact yen precision without collapsing proposed, enacted, supplementary, or settlement states.
